data.description:
Follow-up soak validation for bug 7495-36ea-df75-4a3d (centauric-gnomic-hake), whose fix landed 2026-09-06: Copilot/Claude/Codex Serena all point at ~/.rebar-serena-mirror (Gerrit change 2725, commit 53d18aad2ab9 on main, removed the tracked .codex/config.toml serena entry), ~/rebar/.serena/project.yml gained explicit ignored_paths, and mem-sentinel (com.joeoakhart.mem-sentinel launchd agent, 5-min interval) now logs ORPHAN lines for PPID-1 copilot/uv/serena processes and reaps copilot orphans >24h and uv/serena orphans >1h (REAPED lines).

Acceptance criteria:
1. On or after 2026-09-13, review ~/Library/Logs/mem-sentinel.log (and .log.1 rotation) covering at least 7 days of normal multi-agent use.
2. No python/serena process >1GB RSS blocked >24h appears in the top5 snapshots.
3. Any ORPHAN/REAPED lines are reviewed: REAPED events confirm the reaper works as designed; recurring ORPHAN churn (new orphans appearing daily) is evidence of an upstream harness bug and warrants a new bug ticket with the log excerpt.
4. Findings recorded as a comment here; if clean, close.
data.title: Soak-validate Serena mirror + orphan-reaper fix: one week of clean mem-sentinel logs
